bug_semantics: Authenticated stored XSS (CWE-79) in Akaunting report description rendering. A user who can create or update reports may persist arbitrary HTML/JavaScript in Report.description (validation is required|string only; CreateReport/UpdateReport mass-assign request fields). At 3.1.21 that stored value is emitted without Blade encoding in two admin sinks: (1) the shared textarea used by report create/edit, resources/views/components/form/input/textarea.blade.php line 26 `>{!! $value !!}` plus the group wrapper value="{!! $value !!}", so a `` breakout executes on the edit page; (2) the reports index card, resources/views/common/reports/index.blade.php line 51 `{!! $report->description !!}`, which parses the payload as HTML. CVE.org CVE-2026-11994 is PUBLISHED (not rejected/withdrawn); GHSA withdrawn_at is null. Fluid Attacks disclosed 2026-06-22 against 3.1.21 with no patch then; the sinks are encoded and strip_tags is added in 80ef6d3b, first released in 3.2.0.
